reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Manual multi-view identity: both show the same seated Deacon on a motorcycle, extended left arm gripping handlebar, right arm aiming a pistol, characteristic gray cap, vest and crossbody sling, rolled rear camping bag and corpse/ruins beneath bike. Production cover is a tight woodland-framed crop; source view 1 is a wider red-toned front view and views 2-5 show gray sculpt geometry. Different camera/background yields high dHash distance, so identity relies on correspondences of sculptural elements and secondary views, never the perceptual hash alone.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Human multi-view sculpture, pose, base and object correspondence, corroborated by SHA-256 and perceptual evidence. Different camera crops explain when perceptual distance is large; hash never automatically authorizes mapping.
